name: Malcolm J. Ervin
prior_offices: Platte County clerk (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Malcolm J. Ervin is the Platte County clerk and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official general election summary lists him with 2,839 votes, ahead of Independent Dean S. L. Baker, who received 527.
